expected_effects: Confirmation of cube position relative to box walls
preconditions: Robot has visual access to the box interior

expected_effects: Determination of whether release action is needed or already done
preconditions: Cube is confirmed inside box boundaries

expected_effects: Robot prepares to manipulate cube for better placement
preconditions: Cube is unstable or not fully seated

expected_effects: Cube is repositioned centrally in the box

goal_interpretation: The task requires placing a blue cube inside a transparent box and releasing it. Visual evidence suggests the blue cube is already positioned inside the transparent container. The primary objective shifts to verifying this spatial relationship and ensuring the object is stably resting (released) rather than being held or precariously balanced.

nodes.description: Initial observation of the scene showing the blue cube inside the transparent box.
observable_conditions: Blue cube is visually contained within the transparent box boundaries
Transparent box is stationary on the table
unknown_conditions: Whether the cube is currently grasped by the robot arm (out of view)
Stability of the cube's placement (is it resting on the bottom?)

nodes.description: Confirm the spatial relationship that the cube is strictly inside the box.
observable_conditions: Cube center is within box perimeter
No part of the cube extends beyond box walls
unknown_conditions: Depth perception accuracy regarding cube bottom vs box bottom

nodes.description: Verify if the cube is stably resting on the box bottom and not held.
observable_conditions: No gripper visible holding the cube
unknown_conditions: Friction between cube and box bottom

nodes.description: Task complete: Blue cube is inside the transparent box and released.
observable_conditions: Cube remains inside box after verification
Robot arm is retracted or idle

nodes.description: Fallback action if cube is found to be unstable or outside.
observable_conditions: Cube is tilted or partially outside
unknown_conditions: Required force to nudge cube into center

objects.description: A solid blue cubic block located centrally within the scene.
A clear, open-top rectangular container sitting on the table surface.
The orange planar surface supporting the transparent box.

physical_checks: Verify the blue cube is actually resting on the bottom surface of the transparent box and not floating or stuck to the side.
Ensure the transparent box does not slide on the table when interacting with the cube.
Check if the cube fits loosely or tightly; tight fit may require precise alignment for release.
